items.title: Water Sector Cyberattacks Reportedly Hit at Least 12 States
items.description: Georgia has been confirmed as one of the attacked states after Clayton County reported a pump station disruption. The post Water Sector Cyberattacks Reportedly Hit at Least 12 States appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: QuickFox Supply Chain Attack Delivers FDMTP Backdoor via Trojanized Windows Installer
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed what has been described as a "long-standing supply chain attack" on QuickFox, a virtual private network (VPN) and network acceleration tool designed for overseas Chinese users.
